Separately test whether downstream TEST_ONLY CREATE is invariant. A diagnostic receipt dependency is not native effect enforcement.
B. Separate CAN011 permission: freeze full technical CREATE positive plus missing-grant denial; force the existing permission validity branch to reject every grant. Same CREATE assertion must RED; exact restore must pass. Also remove missing-grant check to challenge negative assertion.
C. Committed mediator: freeze full chain and cold later state read; sever actual store target read in candidate later consumer. Same read assertion RED; restored pass.
D. Actor/event source: freeze admitted actor record hash and admitted event/readset positive; sever original record/event source binding in actual ingress. Same source-bound assertion RED; restore pass. These prove transport binding only; original-source authentication is separately challenged by cases 1/2.
